product_metadata.title: Vremi 12 Piece Nonstick Bakeware Set - Multi Size Baking Sheet and Baking Pans in Non Stick Carbon Steel with Red Silicone Handles - Kitchen Essentials for Roasting Cake Muffin Cookie Pizza and More
features: 12 ESSENTIAL BAKING PANS and SHEETS - Out set has it all, with 3 cookie sheets, 2 roaster pans, 2 muffin pans, 1 pie pan, 1 round cake pan, 1 square baking pan, 1 loaf pan and even a pizza crisper. With all these options, you’ll have a complete bakeware set to infuse your home with delicious homemade treats

VERSATILE SQUARE and ROUND PANS - Whatever size or style, our pans can make it. Our Small and large size bakeware comes in square, rectangle and round shapes: that means you’ll be ready for roasting veggies, baking cakes, making muffin, meatloaf, pizza and more. All these pans fit in both standard and convection oven and nest perfectly for easy storage

MADE OF STURDY NONSTICK CARBON STEEL - Our pans are created from sturdy BPA free carbon steel metal with non stick coating to prevent food from sticking for easy food release. That means our pans are lightweight but built tough, won't crack or hold odor, and are even scratch resistant

EVEN HEAT DISTRIBUTION - Our pans provide even heat distribution to deliver perfectly browned baked goods. Each durable baking pans can withstand temperature up to 450˚F. With all that strength and flexibility, our bakeware set makes it perfect for a wedding gift, for baking upstarts, or for anyone who moved into a new apartment

WITH EASY GRIP HANDLES - We designed our pans with non-slip silicone handles to increase grip--making all our pans easy to transfer out of the oven. Handles are removable during washing. Hand wash pans with warm soap and water to preserve quality. Wash before first-time use
description: It’s time to bake your groove thang with the Vremi
12 Piece Disco Baking Inferno Set

. Whether you like your crusts crispy or your bread fluffy, we’ve got the goods to take you there. Our baking set offers a variety of sizes and styles of baking pans. Made from high quality non toxic materials that won't rust or warp easily even with multiple uses so you can keep cookin’. All our pans are safe to use in standard or convection ovens and great for serving an evenly browned sweet treat for your kids. Each professional nonstick pan doesn't need any oils, grease, foil or parchment paper for easy food removal. So turn up the heat and get down with your bad baking self.
